expected: All staged list/cursor/IPv4 chunk/IPv6 chunk/count APIs exclude disabled and missing external sources while preserving user and active-generation semantics.
observed: Host SQL tests now pass for disable/re-enable/delete and both chunk variants; actual Room dispatcher and platform execution remain pending.
fix: Reuse ROOT_STAGE_ACTIVE_SOURCE_WHERE for ROOT_STAGE_MATERIALIZED_SOURCE_WHERE; no schema or SourceModel/SourceLoader changes.

title: Copied staged redirects choose import IDs over source priority
reproduction: Prepatch extracted insertion/dedupe SQL retained source3 1.1.1.1 over source2 9.9.9.9 and same-source 9.9.9.9 over canonical 1.1.1.1; reverse-order control included.
expected: Copied export agrees with getActiveExactRedirectEntry regardless of import order using user precedence then source ID then canonical address.
observed: Host SQL comparison against the actual runtime redirect query now passes in both orders including user override and duplicate address ties. Android wildcard dispatch/allow-skip pipeline remains pending.

test_evidence: API34 RootExportStagingTest: all3 passed; canonical redirect priority in both import orders and large copied fallback verified. Three host SQL tests pass. No privileged root runtime claim.

title: SAF modification milliseconds are interpreted as epoch seconds
reproduction: Return COLUMN_LAST_MODIFIED=1700000000000 from a content provider and import its hosts file. Read persisted local/online modification dates.
expected: Online date is 2023-11-14T22:13:20Z; local body-fetch date stays near the import time. Unknown provider timestamp remains unknown.
observed: Pre-fix source-confirmed behavior: getFileLastUpdate calls the seconds converter directly; both stored dates can become year 55840 because local date takes max(now, online). A later missing timestamp cannot trigger the weekly age fallback while that future local date persists.
fix: Implemented cursor.isNull guard and Instant.ofEpochMilli(...).atZone(UTC) at SAF boundary; epoch-seconds storage unchanged. Successful re-import replaces corrupt old dates. Existing unknown-metadata successful-import fallback to fetch time retained. Awaiting Android tests; no automatic metadata migration.
test_evidence: Batch-one API34 run: all timestamp/null-date and corrupt-metadata repair regressions passed. 75/76 total connected cases passed; sole failure was unrelated disabled-source historical-error assertion, corrected for rerun. No automatic migration: next successful import repairs old dates.

title: Targeted local-file updates still fail while offline
reproduction: Reuse SourceModelOfflineFileTest offline ContextWrapper and success.txt FILE source, then call retrieveHostsSource(id) or retrieveHostsSources(singletonList(id)). Also checkForUpdate with only a local source.
expected: Local-only targeted updates/checks work without network; only enabled URL downloads/checks require connectivity.
observed: Pre-fix source-confirmed behavior: Targeted helper throws NO_CONNECTION before reading source/type/enabled state. Check-only entry also rejects before enumerating sources. Full checkAndRetrieveHostsSources was fixed in October, but these entry points were not.
fix: Implemented target classification after existing mutation gate; only enabled URL needs network. Check-only scans enabled source types before connectivity check. Full-update security/publication policy unchanged. Awaiting Android tests.
test_evidence: SourceModelOfflineFileTest: all 15 cases passed in full batch-three, including targeted file offline and disabled URL cleanup. Historical error preservation assertion corrected without changing production behavior.

title: Periodic check never retries a never-downloaded source without Last-Modified
reproduction: Leave an enabled HTTPS subscription with localModificationDate=null after an initial failed download. Have subsequent successful HEAD responses omit Last-Modified. Invoke checkForUpdate repeatedly or the periodic worker with this as its only source.
expected: A source with no successful local download remains update-needed and periodic work attempts retrieval.
observed: Pre-fix source-confirmed behavior: Null remote date enters a branch requiring non-null local date older than a week. Null never ages, so checkForUpdate returns false every time and the periodic worker skips retrieval. DAO countOutdated already correctly reports it as outdated.
fix: Implemented null local date as sufficient update-needed state before weekly unknown-remote fallback. Preserves successful-empty-source semantics. Awaiting Android tests.
test_evidence: Batch-one API34 run: failedFirstDownloadWithoutLastModifiedRemainsUpdateNeeded and successfulEmptySourceWithoutLastModifiedUsesWeeklyRefresh passed, with local unknown-date controls. Real scheduled-worker end-to-end remains separate pending coverage.

title: Hosts-format aliases after the first hostname are silently discarded
reproduction: Import a normal blocking source containing 0.0.0.0 ads.one.example ads.two.example # shared block, then resolve both names.
expected: Both valid hostnames on the hosts record are imported and blocked; comments are ignored.
observed: Pre-fix source-confirmed behavior: Regex captures only IP and first hostname and discards the rest via .*. Parser returns one HostListItem; second alias is not imported and the line is not counted as skipped. Host-side regex probe confirmed only ads.one.example is captured.
fix: Implemented streaming alias-token iteration before hash comments, validating/enqueuing each alias through existing host/redirect guards. Keeps non-host/allowlist parsing and SQL deduplication; partially malformed records counted once. Awaiting Android tests.
test_evidence: Batch-one API34: four new SourceLoaderDatabaseSemanticsTest alias regressions passed through SQL/Room and runtime lookup, including comments, invalid aliases, redirects and deduplication.
